messages:
Leah M: Draft plan: before flipping defaults from v1->v2, add a "dry-run preview" in console and a sampled API so customers can see routing & cost impact. Need quick feedback on API surface and telemetry.
Omar K: +1. API should be read-only and return: simulated split, tokens-by-version, projected bill delta, and a list of routes likely to hit a v1 cap. Example: `GET /internal/routes/{id}/simulate?window=24h&sample=0.05`.
Priya D: Telemetry: tag these simulation requests with `simulation=true` and low-cardinality `simulation_cohort=pilot|all`. Do not add per-tenant high-card tags. Send detailed per-request diffs to logs for sampled tenants only.
Console UX: UI idea: small banner on route page: "Preview migration to v2" -> modal with three columns: Current | Simulated | Delta. Include a CTA: Request exemption / Apply change. Keep copy reassuring.
Leah M: On enforcement: if tenant would exceed v1 fallback quota in preview, highlight that row and show exact `X-V1-Estimated-Overage`. We should return a 200 with payload explaining which tenants/routes would be capped.
Omar K: Also include a dry_run header in API responses `X-Simulated:true` and example payload in docs. Infra wants deterministic sampling so simulation is reproducible.
Priya D: For metrics, emit `deprec.preview.requested` event with low-cardinality fields and `deprec.preview.sample_rate` numeric. We'll use that to slice alerts.
Console UX: Copy suggestion: "Try a simulation of switching this route to v2 for 24h. Estimates are based on recent traffic and may vary." We'll A/B test phrasing.
Leah M: Runbook: block auto-flip if >2% of simulated tenants would hit a v1 cap in 1h or if v2 error-rate increase >0.3% absolute in simulation cohort.
telemetry-bot: Note: ensure simulation logs are TTL'd differently to avoid long-term storage costs.
Leah M: Action items: Omar -> API schema + deterministic sampling; Priya -> telemetry tags + log retention; Console UX -> modal mock + copy variants. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize.
Console UX: I'll mock two copy variants and drop screenshots in the ticket by EOD. :rocket:
